description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Customer finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account exists and is logged in <credentials for a customer account>. The customer has an order ready to be completed at checkout <at least one item in the cart / an order ready for checkout>.
steps: Go to the checkout for the prepared order.
Complete the checkout by finishing the order.
Observe the page shown after the checkout is finished.
cases.expected: The checkout can be finished and a confirmation is shown to the customer. The exact content and wording of the confirmation is not specified in the story.
